subject.title: refactor(talk): add realtime voice session harness and adopt in google-meet and voice-call

question: Should `createRealtimeVoiceSessionHarness` become a supported public plugin SDK contract now, before the planned Discord adoption validates the abstraction against the remaining realtime voice consumer?
rationale: The PR adds a broad lifecycle API to a compatibility-sensitive public SDK; tests can validate mechanics, but only maintainers can decide whether this is the intended permanent plugin boundary and whether the contract is mature enough to ship.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Approve the public harness after complete owner review and live Google Meet and voice-call equivalence evidence.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Keep consolidation narrower until Discord adoption or another consumer demonstrates that the API is transport-independent and complete.

options.title: Pause the consolidation
options.body: Leave the current per-consumer wiring in place if the stable SDK commitment outweighs the deduplication benefit.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the public harness after complete owner review and live Google Meet and voice-call equivalence evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history shows ownership of the preceding Google Meet and shared voice-stack consolidation phases.
